scope: Synthetic code review; no market data read by the reproducer. Historical frequency and P&L impact not measured. Simulator source unchanged.
interpretation: A successful run confirms the documented defects reproduce, not that the simulator is correct.

findings.issue: Cancel-pending orders are matched before better-priced replacements.
findings.witness: Old bid 49 live at 40 ms, replacement bid 50 live at 50 ms, old cancel effective at 95 ms. A 5-share sell through both at 60 ms fills 49, violating the intended price priority.
findings.fix: Sort every fillable order by price, then activation time, including all cancel-pending orders; preserve shared trade-volume accounting.

findings.issue: The new ladder engine ignores cancel-pending orders in post-only checks and own-cross diagnostics.
findings.witness: At 50 ms, live bid 51 and cancel-pending ask 51 coexist; reported own_cross remains 0.
findings.fix: Include every fillable own order in activation checks and crossing diagnostics, and refuse invalid paths.

findings.issue: Policy risk: missing or stale V0 guard predictions permit quoting; whether this is a defect depends on the intended fallback.
findings.witness: One fill with a missing market guard, zero with an adverse fresh guard, one again after that adverse guard becomes stale.
findings.fix: Report unavailable guard inputs explicitly; withhold the affected side if guard coverage is required.

controls: Unchanged-price and older-better-price controls pass; fresh adverse guard prevents fills; unsupported split/amend configuration is refused.
